answer: Rhythm Gate delays each new identity's first action until its request pattern shows human-like gaps. An echo of prior traffic must arrive offset by randomized pauses, not in lockstep bursts. Identities emitting a velvet-smooth constant stream get throttled to low priority until their timing drifts. Each clone therefore burns operator hours or proxy spend to fake dune-like irregular spacing across thousands of sessions, a per-identity cost that scales with waiting time.
